title: Makabe’s betrayal & the birth of CHAOS
summary: Toru Yano abandons Togi Makabe as Shinsuke Nakamura builds CHAOS from the remains of Great Bash Heel. Makabe’s response becomes a pursuit of the man who took his allies and the heavyweight championship.

chapters.title: Yano turns against Makabe
chapters.context: Most of Makabe’s former allies move toward Nakamura’s new faction. Honma remains loyal as Makabe becomes the wronged protagonist.

chapters.title: Makabe wins the heavyweight championship
chapters.result: Makabe defeats Nakamura for the IWGP title.
chapters.context: The title victory pays off his chase after the betrayal and establishes him as more than a displaced faction leader.
